record_notes.DCP-LETT-1920: July 8, supplied 1856, eight retained blocks, full footnotes and bibliography read. Thanks two missing Lyell notes and the map now examined; books still to be lent. One week of work on Hooker floras is separate from a month on broader distribution question. Iceberg explanation remains speculative pending boulders, and tropical cooling/modification combination remains difficult. Lyell journal note quoted in apparatus is a separate witness, not either lost note verbatim. Earlier July5 Darwin letter is same-author antecedent context, never an incoming prompt. Received map cannot be merged with promised books or confidently identified with different Maury sailing-directions entry.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1984: November 10, supplied 1856, seven retained blocks, all notes and bibliography read. Charles answers Lady Lyell note addressed to Emma because Emma cannot easily write; no surviving prompt wording here and no Emma prose in this reply. November6 death of aunt is past, projected January visit not accomplished. Big Book now replaces preliminary sketch and acceleration is attributed to Lyell. Bosquet drawing report in P6 is already known in September9 Darwin reply1952; vague other day is not new November discovery or receipt date. Claimed Chalk barnacle challenges negative evidence in Darwin current view; later Bosquet taxonomic correction remains future. Madeleine paper expectation is not completed submission.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2039: Supplied January16,1857 from Darwin ink annotation, incomplete Lyell memorandum. All24 blocks, dated annotation, five notes and bibliography read; first21 blocks form flattened mammal occurrence list with no HTML table. Preserve headings, all zero rows, Middle Purbeck12, Stonesfield4, Trias/Stuttgardt1 and raw joined hiatus/Secondary row without inventing column structure. Counts reflect known finds, not proof of actual absence. Paid-for Microlestes casts/drawings reported as owned by Lyell, not enclosed or seen by Darwin. Missing ending after now & retained. Darwin docket provides catalogue date but not independently precise receipt/reading time. Footnote2 directs to January17 Hooker letter, but surviving2040 concerns Daniell and does not substantiate mammal-list knowledge.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2050: February11, supplied1857, eleven retained blocks, full eleven notes and bibliography read. Advice for Austrian global expedition conditional on itinerary freedom, not merely a proposed trip to Australia as editorial summary says. Recommends remote-island collecting, fossils, glaciation, books and tropical dredging; later route and1857 thanks remain future. P9 same Helix pomatia alive after current20-day seawater immersion and a separate7-day bath about six weeks earlier; not27 continuous days. Mr Forbes probably David in apparatus, not a certain identity. P11 coal plant and Purbeck-fossil news is nonspecific; relation to incomplete January16 list remains a source-identity lead, with no twelve/four/one counts or explicit January-letter acknowledgement. Missing immediate Lyell communication not reconstructed.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2077: April13, supplied1857, three retained blocks, all five notes and bibliography read. Darwin has seen a missing Wollaston-to-Lyell letter about two faunas. He opposes general continental extensions but allows possible proof in particular cases; does not accept Wollaston has proved one. Editorial quoted1857 book passage suggests subject, not missing letter wording. Body says seen, whereas summary says returns; do not infer return dispatch from summary. Madeira separate copy requested when printed, not already received or read. Hydropathy intended in a week for a fortnight; actualApril22–May6 itinerary separate from predicted dates.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1952: Additional Bosquet witness September9, supplied1856, four surviving blocks ending mid-sentence, all seven footnotes and full bibliography read. Incoming discovery letter and supplied drawings explicitly received, but absent here. Darwin treats presumed Cretaceous Chthamalus as overturning negative evidence, recommends publication, and qualifies anatomical impressions because out of practice. Actual fossil identification later corrected by Bosquet; later modern record must not overwrite1856 belief. P4 uncertain Lithotrya/carina interpretation and mistaken Balanidae plate reference remain raw with Lepadidae editorial correction separate. No drawing images supplied in this letter source and no complete inbound text for pairing.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1910: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. June 25, supplied 1856, seven retained blocks, all notes and bibliography read. Five-part geological argument replies to June 17; explicit before I got your letter versus now I must strike my colours records changed judgment about subsidence. Ramsay discussion is an additional oral input, with possible June 18 meeting not certain date. Copied letter corrected/completed by Darwin; original draft distinct. P3 Geographical is an uncorrected copyist reading where draft geological differs; preserve sent-copy wording and variant provenance. Hooker reading is requested conditionally, not accomplished dispatch/receipt. Darwin does not claim accidental transport already explains every case. Later Origin discussion is future, and species essay wording does not establish a published contemporary book.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1917: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. July 5, supplied 1856, seven retained blocks, all eight notes and bibliography read. Darwin acknowledges long Lyell answer, presses for verdict and answers volcanic subsidence/elevation arguments in P1–4. The surviving July 1 journal extract supports this section; its expressly unsent July 2 postscript is not a prompt. P5 permission to credit Lyell and proposed wording refers a missing part of the incoming letter: exclude it from an apparently source-complete pair based only on 1915A. Lyell dedication notebook quotation is separate modern apparatus, its June 29 date unverified and use as sent reply uncertain. Salutation, date, valediction and postscript are Darwin hand; main copy corrected by Darwin. Notions qualified throughout; apparent published-at-your-suggestion language concerns the proposed essay, not proof of publication. Later 1874 retained geological view remains future.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1915A: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. Additional Lyell contemporary journal extract headed July 1, 1856, fifteen blocks, full notes/bibliography and all three actual figures read. Original sent letter missing; copy/extract is not proof of full dispatch extent. Volcanic elevation versus broad ocean subsidence debated with qualified mechanism, not a settled universal law. Source 12,000-foot sounding conflicts with apparatus 1,200; preserve discrepancy. P9 genuine MathML means one-half million years, not 12 million. First journal diagram is reportedly dated June 1 against July 1 heading, an unresolved layer. Drawings show hypothetical sea levels/volcano/deformed layers, littoral flanking beds and Grand Canary overlap; no measured scale. July 2 postscript in footnote 8 is expressly NOT sent to Darwin and cannot be incoming memory. 1919 P2 acknowledges main Lyell answer by July 5, while extent of copy/diagrams received remains limited.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1919: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. Evening July 5, supplied 1856, all thirteen blocks, notes and bibliography. P1 develops Tristan/Antarctic-continent question from morning letter. P2 acknowledges Lyell long reply, P3 requests forwarding of Darwin’s letter, which is not yet established as done. P4–10 directly answer 1911: Flora/Laburnum translation and follow-up, Entada establishment, Aristolochia/Viscum and stigma readiness, parthenogenesis, Aldrovanda with remembered Candolle parallel, and Ray Society policy based on own Cirripedia experience. P11 £20 is pledge, not February 1857 recorded payment. P13 asks for intermediate-variety examples after Wollaston; other subject and missing prior cases. Editorial summary belongs to morning 1918. Receipt of Hooker note some days ago is relative, not an exact date. Lyell source is a journal extract of missing original, so known-by acknowledgement does not prove every retained diagram or unsent postscript was received.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2040: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. January 17, supplied 1857, two blocks and complete notes/bibliography. Friday January 16 Daniell/Bennett discussions after January 15 Club. Advice on possible grant and collector project, not award or expedition already executed. Daniell zeal/experience, Hooker reservations, Bennett qualified support and perceived mortality risk are attributed reports. Darwin will follow consultation; no preserved specific current Hooker communication. Later Niger locality criticism in apparatus is not already established January 17. Hooker year endorsement possibly retrospective; meeting corroborates supplied year.

visual_readings.visual_observation: Two schematic panels: A/B/C terrain with F volcano, B–D and G relative sea levels and deep K–L baseline; lower H mound, p/q marine surfaces, curved m/n/o beneath m-prime/o-prime. No measured scale; illustrates regional subsidence and local volcanic uplift.
H is a low central swell with q at left and p at right, stippled marine beds at the flanks above baselines; this is the hypothetical littoral-deposit comparison, not quantitative data.
Grand Canary labelled section: inclined marine beds overlap older subaerial rocks, rising terrain to the right; no numerical dimensions. Supports relative stratigraphic geometry only.

reading_method: Root independently read complete surviving new source bodies, metadata constraints, exclusions, footnotes, scholarly sections and bibliography. Actual special markup and figures inspected where present. Reused explicit accepted primary readings only after matching source and accepted evidence hashes. Historical decisions and notes are handwritten; validation packages evidence rather than adjudicating it.
